ns2:course.label: Intro to the World of Islam
ns2:course.description: Introduction to the world of Islam. Islamic thought and traditional institutions; historical expansion and evolution of the Islamic world in pre-modern and modern times; state, society and cultures in different world regions; gender issues; artistic expression; family life; language and identity; literary expression; issues in economic development; human rights; Christian-Muslim relations; debates over Sharia vs. secular law. Same as HIST 133. This course can be used to fulfill either Western or Nonwestern general education categories, but not both.
